raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) delivered customer_id without zero-padding ('C180', 'C3', 'C94' instead of 'C00180', etc.), so those roughly 363 posted rows fail the inner join to silver_customers, which uses 'C00001'..'C00200'. The 363 dropped rows match batch 14's 378 rows less its reversals. The values map one-to-one to the padded format, so normalizing the key in silver fixes gold_region_daily and also gold_customer_spend.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
